subject: Coord: cashflow sync — split payment & VAT docs needed
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Lee <accounts@novaforge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Dec 2029 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Coord: cashflow sync — split payment & VAT docs needed

Hi Hannah,

Hope you had a good weekend — quick follow up on Invoice #RWF-2029-1123 (attached). Our AP team flagged that Novaforge has an upcoming cutover and would like to confirm a split remittance: 50% via virtual card (effective today) and 50% via wire (next Tuesday, 12/10).

Could you confirm the following so we can route payment cleanly?
- OK to split 50/50 (card now / wire 12/10)?
- Wire beneficiary details you prefer on remittance (we have the bank instructions in the invoice but your AP sometimes prefers PO# or entity name variant).
- VAT/residency docs: we need either a VAT registration number or the EU VAT certificate on file so we can mark the invoice correctly. If you can attach a VAT cert or confirm VAT-exempt status, that would speed the wire clearance.

Attached: Invoice_2029-11-30.pdf — if you prefer a single payment we can revise the routing but splitting avoids a hold on your side. If split is fine I can get procurement to push the virtual-card authorization today.
Thanks — I’ll hold off on the card charge until I hear confirmation.

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

Attachment: Invoice_2029-11-30.pdf (PDF, 78 KB)

From: Hannah Lee <accounts@novaforge.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance AP <ap@novaforge.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Dec 2029 10:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Coord: cashflow sync — split payment & VAT docs needed

Hi Priyom,
Thanks for the note — we can do the split as proposed. I attached a short remittance advice and our VAT registration (EU-VAT-00987) for your records. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- On the wire, please list the beneficiary as "Novaforge Inc. (Global Ops)" and include PO 8791 in the reference.
- We use a single entity for card authorizations; the card will be billed today but funds may settle by end of day.
- We will push the second wire on 2029-12-10 morning (ET).

Copying our AP team for visibility. If you need a different remittance format let me know.

Hannah
Hannah Lee
Accounts Payable Lead, Novaforge Inc.
accounts@novaforge.com | +1 212-555-0199
Attachment: RemittanceAdvice_Novaforge_20291203.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Lee <accounts@novaforge.com>, Finance AP <ap@novaforge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Dec 2029 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Coord: cashflow sync — split payment & VAT docs needed
Thanks Hannah — that works.
Plan I will execute after this note (please consider this confirmation):
1) Authorize virtual card for 50% today (card will be charged after internal approval).
2) Schedule wire for 2029-12-10 morning ET to the beneficiary name you specified. We will include PO 8791 in the wire reference.

Kimberly / Monica — please approve the card authorization for $42,750 (50% of invoice) and confirm we can include "Novaforge Inc. (Global Ops) / PO 8791" as the wire reference. Also note the external provided EU VAT number: EU-VAT-00987 — please attach to the invoice when we mark it settled to avoid VAT holdbacks.

Monica: if treasury flags any entity mismatch, we will route the wire through our US operating entity; flag here if that would cause tax withholding for Novaforge.

Hannah: once the card is authorized I will send the DocuSign link for the virtual-card charge authorization (we use it for audit). Expect that link in ~20 minutes.

Thanks all — Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
Attachment: Invoice_2029-11-30.pdf (PDF, 78 KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 3 Dec 2029 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: approve virtual-card charge + wire reference (Novaforge)

Kimberly / Monica — internal quick note (threaded here for audit):

- Customer: Novaforge Inc. (D-2029-1447)
- Invoice: RWF-2029-1123 — total $85,500; proposed split 50/50 (card today / wire 12/10)
- External provided VAT: EU-VAT-00987 (attached earlier)

Request: please approve the virtual-card authorization for $42,750 and confirm we can include the wire reference text exactly as: "Novaforge Inc. (Global Ops) / PO 8791". Also confirm whether routing the wire through RWF US Ops (instead of RWF UK) will trigger any withholding for Novaforge — if it could, we should advise the customer.

I’ve uploaded the invoice and remittance note to the HubSpot record (link below) for bookkeeping.
Thanks — I’ll hold the DocuSign authorization until I see your OK.
Priyom
